validity.recommendation: Treat as unverified GEM-only entity; pull the original source dataset/schematic the 'UA-1 / km199' node label came from before keeping, and check it is not a relabeled duplicate of P1907 (Haradh-3-Uthmaniya).
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: No independent source anywhere names this pipeline or its specs. Every external web hit for 'UA-1-km199-Uthmaniya', for a 108 km Uthmaniya gas line, or for a 24/32-inch line to Uthmaniya resolves only to GEM's own pages (gem.wiki). Searched EN and AR (Argaam/SPA/Aramco/attaqa/albayan); Arabic returned only generic Aramco MGS financing/compression articles, none describing this segment. The gem.wiki page itself is near-empty: no start point, no start year, no capacity, no route, no other-names, only Operator/Owner=Saudi Aramco and Length 108 km, Diameter 24,32 in. SOURCES vs GEM: the page's only two refs are OPEC Annual Statistical Bulletins (ASB 2012 p.75; ASB 2017 p.92). Both URLs are alive (ASB2012 200; ASB2017 was 402 on fetch) but the verifier shows ASB2012 does not even contain the token 'pipeline'; OPEC ASBs are country-level aggregate oil/gas statistics tables and cannot support an individual pipeline's diameter or length — the Diameter footnote [2] pointing to ASB 2017 p.92 is implausible. So both existing refs are non-supporting filler, not evidence this pipe exists. NAMING: the label follows an Aramco internal line-code scheme ('UA-1' a trunk-line code, 'km199' a kilometer post) — the real, independently-attested codes for this corridor are HDUG-1 (Haradh-Uthmaniyah gas line) and HUG-1 (Hawiyah-Uthmaniyah gas line) per MEED; 'UA-1' is not attested in any independent source. The whole P1897-P1925 block looks bulk-extracted from one Aramco schematic/dataset using internal node codes. DUPLICATE RISK (secondary): P1907 'Haradh-3-Uthmaniya' (len=124, dia=24,32) and this P1908 (len=108, dia=24,32) both terminate at Uthmaniya and share the unusual exact diameter pair 24,32 — possible twin extractions of one physical line under two node labels; could not confirm or refute without the source dataset. SPEC: 108 km and 24/32 in are uncorroborated by any independent source. CONCLUSION: cannot independently confirm this pipeline exists as a distinct entity; refs on the page do not support it. The MEED Hawiyah-pipeline article is cited as supporting context: it independently documents the real Uthmaniyah gas-line network and naming (HDUG-1 48in/25km, HUG-1 56in/1km, plus 24in/57km NGL and 28in/58km NGL lines) and does NOT include any 'UA-1' or 108 km / 24,32-in line, reinforcing that this entity is not independently attested.
